title: bug: daemon vitest inherits the agent seat's MOE_* env, so 4 getContext.test.ts cases fail under any QA/architect seat and every gate run needs a scrubbed re-run
description:
Agent seats export MOE_WORKER_ID and other identity variables: MOE_SESSION_ID, MOE_ATTEMPT_ID, MOE_ATTEMPT_GENERATION, MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT, MOE_RUNNER_HOST, MOE_WORKER_TYPE, MOE_PROJECT_PATH, MOE_TASK_ID and others. packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts sets test.env only for MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE, so all of these leak into the daemon suite.

getContext.ts reads the caller as `params.workerId || process.env.MOE_WORKER_ID`, at about line 337. A seat whose MOE_WORKER_ID starts with qa- therefore gets role-trimmed context, and 4 cases in src/tools/getContext.test.ts fail: `result.task.epicSiblings` is undefined. Only some cases in that file stub the variable, at lines 211-223 and 763-766.

Recurrence: Serena gotcha-daemon-tests-ambient-moe-worker-id has been recorded since 2026-10-24 and reconfirmed on CQ-M01b, WT-01 (c33e2a69) and 054cc7c6 (68df7f1f, qa-ba3f4f35 at 15:12Z on 2026-10-30). gotcha-agent-session-env-leaks-into-tests says the same. Each QA gate run from a seat fails first, is diagnosed again, then re-runs with MOE_* scrubbed. The note itself says "a real fix would be ... (separate task)", and none was ever filed.

Precedent: packages/moe-proxy/vitest.config.ts already blanks a list of seat variables in test.env, with the comment "every reader treats blank as unset; a test that needs one sets it". Mirror that in the daemon config and keep the MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE redirect. Build the blank list from a grep of `process.env.MOE_` reads under packages/moe-daemon/src (non-test files). Before blanking any variable, confirm that no daemon reader distinguishes blank from unset. Tests that need a variable keep stubbing it.

This is test-harness only. No production source changes.
definitionOfDone: Run from a shell with MOE_WORKER_ID=qa-probe, MOE_SESSION_ID=probe@x and MOE_PROJECT_PATH=<a decoy dir> set, `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` passes. Its pass/skip counts equal a run with every MOE_* variable scrubbed, and src/tools/getContext.test.ts has no failure.

packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts blanks every seat-identity MOE_* variable that a non-test daemon module reads, and keeps the existing MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE redirect. The plan names the grep that produced the list, and the commit changes no production source under packages/moe-daemon/src.
Serena gotcha-daemon-tests-ambient-moe-worker-id (and the matching section of gotcha-agent-session-env-leaks-into-tests) is updated to say the trap is fixed at the config, with the commit.

implementationPlan.description:
Blank the seat identity in the daemon's vitest env, and pin it with a test.
(a) packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts: keep the MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE comment and value byte-for-byte. Make `env` an object that holds that entry plus `...Object.fromEntries(['MOE_WORKER_ID', 'MOE_TASK_ID', 'MOE_PROJECT_PATH'].map((name) => [name, '']))`. This is the idiom packages/moe-proxy/vitest.config.ts already uses. Add a comment of 2-3 lines in the proxy's style: agent seats export their identity; daemon modules read it as the caller (src/tools/getContext.ts:336-337) and as the project (src/index.ts:64); blank them here, because every reader treats blank as unset; a test that needs one stubs it. The values must be '' and never undefined: vitest 5.0.5 spreads test.env over the worker's env and then assigns each key through process.env, which would store the string 'undefined'.
The list is the seat-identity part of `grep -rhoE "process\.env\.MOE_[A-Z0-9_]+" packages/moe-daemon/src --include='*.ts' --exclude='*.test.ts' | sort -u` (26 names at ef7497c9). All three of those readers use `||`. Leave the other 23 alone. They are operator settings. MOE_SERENA_PATH (`??`, src/context/semanticSource.ts:73) and MOE_MCP_MAX_BATCH_SIZE (`=== undefined`, src/server/McpAdapter.ts:20,30) treat blank differently from unset. MOE_EXECUTION_PROFILE_READY occurs only in generated workload program text (src/benchmarks/defectWorkloads.ts). Do not copy the proxy's other names (MOE_SESSION_ID, MOE_ATTEMPT_*, MOE_RUNNER_*, MOE_WORKER_TYPE, MOE_DAEMON_HOST): no daemon module reads them, and a full HEAD run with all of them set changed no count.
(b) New packages/moe-daemon/src/vitestEnv.test.ts, about 15 lines (node:os, node:path; describe/it/expect from vitest):
- `it.each` over the three names asserts `expect(process.env[name]).toBe('')`. Make it exact, with no `?? ''`: the config sets '' even when the shell has no value, so a reverted config fails in CI with "expected undefined to be ''", and a leaked seat value fails on a seat.
- One case pins MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE to `path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'moe-vitest-no-accounts', 'claude-accounts.json')`.
- One comment line names the trap: a seat's MOE_WORKER_ID role-trimmed get_context and failed 4 getContext.test.ts cases.
Change no other file under packages/moe-daemon/src. getContext.test.ts and every test that stubs these variables stay as they are: vi.stubEnv and delete-then-restore now restore ''. There is no runtime error handling to add, because no production code changes.
implementationPlan.note: Config blanks MOE_WORKER_ID/MOE_TASK_ID/MOE_PROJECT_PATH; pin test added. Peers' dirty paths (board JSON, .moe/decisions, scripts/mods tsconfigs) untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
Run the gate once, in a snapshot. You cannot run it in the shared checkout. Its packages/moe-daemon/node_modules is Windows-native, so rolldown dies at startup under WSL, and peers keep dirty WIP there.
Build the snapshot as mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate and mem:gotcha-linux-vitest-reuse-native-node-modules describe:
- `SNAP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-6c56-gate.XXXXXX); git archive HEAD | tar -x -C $SNAP` (the whole repo).
- Copy ONLY your two files over it, then `cmp` each against the checkout.
- Give $SNAP/packages/moe-daemon a platform-native node_modules whose package-lock.json matches HEAD (compare after `tr -d '\r'`). Either `cp -al` a matching /tmp install whose `.bin/vitest` is a symlink, or run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` in the snapshot. Never npm install in the shared checkout.
- A native Windows seat runs all of this from Git Bash with Windows-native dependencies.
Red proof first, inside the snapshot only. Overwrite its packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts with `git show HEAD:packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts`, then:
(i) `env $(compgen -e | grep '^MOE_' | sed 's/^/-u /') npx vitest run src/vitestEnv.test.ts` must fail exactly the 3 blank cases with "expected undefined to be ''".
(ii) `MOE_WORKER_ID=qa-probe npx vitest run src/tools/getContext.test.ts` must fail the 4 known cases (epicSiblings undefined).
Copy the fixed config back and `cmp` it again.
Then, from $SNAP, run the verification command exactly as checkRefs gives it. Exit 0 means two things:
- The probe run passed, so getContext.test.ts had no failure. It sets MOE_WORKER_ID=qa-probe, MOE_SESSION_ID=probe@x, MOE_TASK_ID=task-probe and MOE_PROJECT_PATH=a fresh empty dir, on top of the seat's own MOE_* variables.
- Its `Test Files` and `Tests` lines equal those of a run with every MOE_* unset.
Planning baseline at d74ce967 with this change: 210 files, 6068 passed | 20 skipped (6088) on both runs. Peers have landed since, so your counts may differ; only probe == scrubbed matters.
Error handling: the command is one && chain and prints its logs directory first. A failed run, a missing summary line or a count mismatch all exit non-zero. Read $O/probe.log and $O/scrub.log before re-running. Never weaken a test, a timeout or a skip to get green. A one-off IO-load flake (for example the 5s index.version CLI tests) may be re-run once, and you must name it in the step note.
In the step note, record both summary lines, the logs directory and the red-proof outcomes. If HEAD moves before complete_task, re-run only when `git rev-parse <old>:packages/moe-daemon` differs from the same for HEAD.
implementationPlan.note: Gate run in snapshot /tmp/moe-6c56-gate.hhYtYa (HEAD ef7497c9 + my 2 files, cmp-verified; npm ci native deps, lock = HEAD). Red proof (config reverted in snapshot only): (i) vitestEnv.test.ts with MOE_* unset -> 3 failed | 1 passed, "expected undefined to be ''"; (ii) MOE_WORKER_ID=qa-probe getContext.test.ts -> 4 failed | 51 passed (epicSiblings undefined). Fixed config restored + cmp'd. checkRefs exit 0, logs /tmp/tmp.SckULG6GHY. Probe summary == scrubbed: Test Files 210 passed (210); Tests 6071 passed | 20 skipped (6091). No flakes, no re-runs.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of this task's own diff, then complete_task.
Why only this diff: isEpicFinal comes from the highest-order fallback in this rolling catch-all epic, whose siblings are still WORKING. The full daemon suite in step 2 is the regression scope for the only affected package.
Check each of these:
- `git status --short -- packages/moe-daemon` and `git diff -- packages/moe-daemon` show only vitest.config.ts and the new src/vitestEnv.test.ts as yours. Peers' dirty paths and board JSON are not yours: never stage, revert or stash them.
- No production source under packages/moe-daemon/src changed.
- The MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE line and its comment are byte-identical to HEAD.
- The values are '' (not undefined or null), and the names are exactly the three.
- Tests that stub these variables, or delete and restore them, still pass, because they restore ''.
- Children spawned with `{...process.env}` now get '' for the three. Every reader there treats blank as unset: getContext `||`, index.ts `||`, scripts/moe-call.sh `-n "${MOE_PROJECT_PATH:-}"`, and moe-proxy.
- No comment contains a phrase that src/util/daemonGitDocs.test.ts flags: 'never runs/executes/touches git', 'runs no git' or 'does not run git'.
- On Windows, Node keeps '' env values in-process and across spawn (checked on native Node v24.16 during planning).
Then call complete_task with the step-2 command, its exit code and its output tail.

reopenReason: Governor promote under the human's 2026-10-30 delegation of pending decisions. A test-harness-only, one-config-file fix for a trap that has been recurring since 2026-10-24. No open row touches packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts, so it needs no lane edge. 5 architects are idle.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The daemon's vitest suite never sees an agent seat's identity. packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts test.env blanks MOE_WORKER_ID, MOE_TASK_ID and MOE_PROJECT_PATH: these are the seat-identity variables that a non-test daemon module reads. As a result, `npm test` from any seat gives the same pass and skip counts as a run with every MOE_* scrubbed, and getContext.test.ts no longer role-trims under a qa- seat. The change is test-harness only.
acceptanceCriteria: vitest.config.ts test.env holds the unchanged MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE redirect plus MOE_WORKER_ID, MOE_TASK_ID and MOE_PROJECT_PATH mapped to '', using the Object.fromEntries idiom of packages/moe-proxy/vitest.config.ts.
The new src/vitestEnv.test.ts asserts that each of the three is exactly '' and pins the MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE value. With the config reverted, it fails 3 cases even when MOE_* is unset, as in CI.
The checkRefs command exits 0: the probe run passes, and its Test Files and Tests lines equal those of the all-MOE_*-scrubbed run.
Apart from the new test file, the commit changes nothing under packages/moe-daemon/src. getContext.test.ts is untouched.

Serena gotcha-daemon-tests-ambient-moe-worker-id (top status block) and the matching section of gotcha-agent-session-env-leaks-into-tests say the trap is fixed at the config. They cite task-6c56fe88c60f4a8fab7d1fd5508a0f66 with the lookup `git log moe/work-2026-10-24 --grep 'Moe-Task: task-6c56fe88c60f4a8fab7d1fd5508a0f66'`. The worker cannot know the landing sha before complete_task; QA may append the sha from task.commits.
invariants: No production source under packages/moe-daemon/src changes.
Only seat identity that a daemon module reads is blanked. Operator settings stay untouched, including MOE_SERENA_PATH and MOE_MCP_MAX_BATCH_SIZE, which distinguish blank from unset.
Blank values are '' and never undefined.
compatibility: The MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE redirect value and its comment stay byte-identical.
Tests that call vi.stubEnv, or delete and restore these variables, keep working. They now restore '' instead of a seat value.

Children spawned with {...process.env} inherit '' for the three. Each reader treats that as unset: getContext.ts:336-337 `||`, index.ts:64 `|| process.cwd()`, scripts/moe-call.sh `-n "${MOE_PROJECT_PATH:-}"`, and moe-proxy, whose config makes the same claim.
approvedScope: packages/moe-daemon/vitest.config.ts: the test.env block and its comment
reuse: packages/moe-proxy/vitest.config.ts blanks its seat variables with Object.fromEntries(names.map(name => [name, ''])). Mirror it.
sourceAssumptions: At ef7497c9, `grep -rhoE "process\.env\.MOE_[A-Z0-9_]+" packages/moe-daemon/src --include='*.ts' --exclude='*.test.ts' | sort -u` gives 26 names. The seat identity among them is MOE_WORKER_ID, MOE_TASK_ID and MOE_PROJECT_PATH.

vitest 5.0.5 builds the worker env as {...process.env, ...config.env} (dist/chunks/index.1TqnEahn.js ~6107). setupEnv then assigns each key through process.env, so '' is safe and undefined would become 'undefined'.
checkRefs: cd packages/moe-daemon && O=$(mktemp -d) && echo "logs: $O" && env MOE_WORKER_ID=qa-probe MOE_SESSION_ID=probe@x MOE_TASK_ID=task-probe MOE_PROJECT_PATH="$(mktemp -d)" NO_COLOR=1 npm test >"$O/probe.log" 2>&1 && env $(compgen -e | grep '^MOE_' | sed 's/^/-u /') NO_COLOR=1 npm test >"$O/scrub.log" 2>&1 && for f in probe scrub; do sed -E 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$O/$f.log" | grep -aE '^ +(Test Files|Tests) ' >"$O/$f.sum"; done && cat "$O/probe.sum" && diff "$O/probe.sum" "$O/scrub.sum" && echo "probe == scrubbed"

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (a) Per-test vi.stubEnv in getContext.test.ts: rejected. It treats one symptom, and every new test would trip the trap again. (b) A setupFiles module that deletes MOE_*: rejected. The DoD prescribes blanking in the config, and the proxy precedent blanks. (c) Blanking every MOE_* the daemon reads, operator settings included: rejected. MOE_SERENA_PATH (`??`) and MOE_MCP_MAX_BATCH_SIZE (`=== undefined`, which warns) treat blank differently from unset, and settings are not seat identity. (d) undefined values in test.env: rejected, because they would be stringified. (e) Also blanking the proxy's seat list (SESSION/ATTEMPT/RUNNER/WORKER_TYPE/DAEMON_HOST): not needed. No daemon module reads them, and a HEAD run with all of them set changed no count.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Planning evidence from exact HEAD d74ce967 in a Linux snapshot:
- Probe env (seat MOE_* plus MOE_WORKER_ID=qa-probe, MOE_SESSION_ID=probe@x, decoy MOE_PROJECT_PATH): 4 failed | 6060 passed | 20 skipped (6084). The 4 failures are exactly the known getContext cases.
- All MOE_* scrubbed: 6064 passed | 20 skipped (6084).
- No other test differed, per the per-test JSON diff.
With the fix and the pin test in the scratch copy, the checkRefs command exited 0: 210 files, 6068 passed | 20 skipped on both runs. With the config reverted and MOE_* unset, the pin test failed 3 cases with "expected undefined to be ''". Native Windows Node v24.16 keeps '' env values in-process and in spawned children, so the exact toBe('') pin is portable. No launcher exports MOE_TASK_ID today, but the daemon reads it as the task fallback, so it is blanked as identity.
planningNotes.risks:
- Under WSL, the shared checkout's node_modules is Windows-native. Run the gate only in a snapshot of HEAD plus the two owned files, with lock-matching native deps. Never overlay peers' dirty files.
- The vitest log can contain ANSI codes and NUL bytes. The command sets NO_COLOR, strips ANSI and uses grep -a.
- daemonGitDocs.test.ts fails on daemon comments such as 'runs no git'. Keep new comments free of that wording.
- The landing sha is unknown until the wrapper lands the commit, so the memories cite the task id plus the Moe-Task trailer lookup.
- isEpicFinal is an order artifact in a rolling epic. The full daemon suite is the regression scope, and the review covers this task's diff only.
